data.body: [P2] Resolve user names through multiple SDK wrappers. When a `runInChildContext` callback directly throws `PaymentError`, the core checkpoints `ErrorType: "PaymentError"` and throws `ChildContextError → StepError → PaymentError`, on both live execution and replay. Unwrapping once reports execution-level `StepError`, while the corresponding operation reports `PaymentError`. The user type remains available here; it has not been lost during checkpointing. Traverse recognized SDK wrappers until reaching the user error, with cycle protection, and add live/replay coverage for a direct child-context exception.
